profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Cubic Corporation
profile.summary:
Software Architect, Technical Lead and individual contributor.  Consistently used as a resource to resolve technical and program roadblocks.

Primary Areas of Focus:  Embedded Software, Performance Optimization, Stability, High Availability (99.999%), Communication protocols, BSP/Device Drivers,  Physics Simulation and Graphics

positions.title: Principal Architect
positions.description:
Authored Analysis of Android Graphics Pipeline, covering existing design, limitations and proposed solutions.  Includes both designs for incremental and radical architectural changes.
Lead/Primary developer to reduce Android Hardware Rendering CPU usage and memory by 50%.
Design/Prototype to reduce Android UI  buffering by 66% for reduced llatency and memory requirements.
Architect of new Linux smart memory shrinker that understands Android application memory patterns.
Technical lead and primary contributor of a Physics Engine supporting shallow water, Navier-Stokes fluid, Wind, Constraints, Aerodynamics and Thermodynamics.
Architect for 3ds Max plug-in with export capability for physics modeling and tuning.
Authored design document for a near real-time ETC1/ETC2 lossy compressor, including a visual image comparison model.  Primary developer for ETC1 compressor.
Authored design document and user’s guide for a procedural shader based effects engine that applies image processing effects to the Android UI.  Primary developer for engine and shaders.
Technical lead and primary author for Huawei’s Software performance process and tools for ICS.
Responsible for performance of multiple Huawei devices, including the first 7” HoneyComb tablet.
Designed/Developed Linux VM memory shrinker

positions.title: Distinguished Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Technical Lead on major CDMA Android development project.
Participate/Review the HW/SW system architecture, including chipset selection, memory sizes.
Architecture of Android feature add-ons such as Dial up networking, TTY, HAC, backup/restore, and audio routing extensions.  Covering Applications, Frameworks, Hardware abstraction layer and kernel.
Kernel configuration and tunings for optimal performance on reduced memory footprint.
Applications processor stability and panic reporting.
Integration of Linux kernel drivers, including Sensors (Magnetometer, Accelerometer, Orientation, Proximity), backlight, headset detection, RTC, vibrator.
Android Hardware Abstraction integration for sensors, lights, power, audio, graphics, vibrator and Bluetooth.
Android Framework layer integration/technical lead.
Android build configurations to support engineering and final end user configuration.

positions.title: Technical Lead/System Engineer – Sprint Product Group
positions.description:
SW Systems Engineer/Technical lead for the Sprint product development group.
Participate/Review the HW/SW  system architectures for Sprint CMDA roadmap.
Key New/Unique/Difficult Feature Integration Support/Ownership.
Technical lead for the Bluetooth 2.0 Engine, supporting all Motorola CDMA products.
CDMA Engine Software Integration/problem solving.

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Chief responsible for the requirement management/gathering, specifications, and integration of the engine software for eight CDMA phone programs over their product lifecycle.  
Requirement generation, scheduling, estimating work size, and tracking. 
Creation of the initial software packages for over 15 CDMA handsets in support of hardware builds.
Team lead responsibilities include process documentation, process improvements, and performance metrics.
Specialist responsible for core software configuration/integration of over ten product programs during their initial lifecycle phases.  
Reviewed product specifications and schematics to identify missing requirements.  
Resolution of all errors identified by product program prior to the locking down of product requirements.
Creation/Configuration of the memory maps for over 15 CDMA handsets.
Responsible for integration of weekly Nokia Platform software releases into the CDMA code base.

positions.title: Software Lead
positions.description:
Technical lead for the Operations and Maintenance phase of non-voice functionality of the Satellite software for the constellation of 66 Iridium Satellites.   
Technical Lead and individual contributor during the development phase of the constellation. Including Fault Management (99.999% Availability), Command, control, software upgrade, telemetry, and Kband communication links (SV to SV, SV to ground), internal communication protocols, device drivers, memory management, radiation event detection/recovery, and pSOS BSP. 
On-orbit anomaly analysis and resolution, software architecture, system engineering, development, and build content planning.  
Analysis and Design for Fault and Configuration Management of the WITS Digital Modular Radio (DMR) Software Definable Radio.  
Requirement specification, architectural design using UML.  
Manager/Technical lead of the development of the OAM&P infrastructure for the Phase A1 Aspira Core UMTS/GPRS multimedia switch.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Team Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for the architecture, design, and C/C++ implementation of the control platform, including pSOS BSP, device drivers, and the external and internal data communication protocols.  
3000 port ISO router to support the TMN overhead channels of the Large Matrix Cross Connects.   
ISO 7 layer stack, TCP/IP, X.25, X.25 to ISO gateway, TCP/IP to ISO gateway, file servers, MAC bridge, and the administration scheme used for the ISO stack.
